name: Chunker
description: Breaks large amounts of content into sections based on inline headings.
project_description: Chunker is a very basic successor to the Drupal 7 Chunker module by dman. Where the D7 version was a text filter, this rewrite is implemented as a field formatter (id 'chunker') that applies to text_long and text_with_summary fields. For large HTML bodies it injects wrapper div elements to create content sections based on inline h2 (optionally h3) headings within the stored markup, using DOMDocument (Drupal\Component\Utility\Html::load()/serialize()). The re-sectioned markup is then rendered through Drupal's processed_text render element with the field's own text format, so filtering/XSS handling matches the core default text formatter. The wrapping is hierarchical: running from the chosen start level upward toward h1 so higher-level headings contain their subsections rather than merely preceding them. Each chunked heading gets a stable id (respecting an author-supplied id, else 'section-N'), and an optional permalink anchor can be appended to each heading. The added structure lets other modules or CSS provide previous/next navigation, accordions, tabs, or collapsible sections. Configuration is entirely per field display (Manage display); there is no global settings route, no routes, no services, no permissions, and no dependencies beyond Drupal core.
